project.title: Identification of cellular proteins binding to the 3’UTR of Programmed Cell Death 4 mRNA
project.projectDescription: The aim of the project is to identify RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) that interact with the 3’ untranslated region (3’UTR) of the programmed cell death 4 (PDCD4) mRNA. PDCD4 is an inflammatory tumor suppressor gene. The translation of PDCD4 mRNA is regulated by multiple RBPs. The aim is to identify RBPs which are critical for regulating PDCD4 mRNA translation by binding to its 3’UTR. For this purpose, a biotinylated PDCD4 3’UTR RNA was incubated with cytoplasmic lysate from MCF7 human breast carcinoma cells and the RNA-protein complexes pulled down by streptavidin affinity chromatography. The proteins were then eluted and resolved by SDS-PAGE. One particular protein band, migrating close to 55 KDa marker was cut out and submitted for proteomic analysis by in gel digestion and mass spectrometry.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: MCF7 cells were resuspended in S10 cell lysis buffer [ 10mM HEPES pH 7.4, 15mM KCl, 1mM PMSF and 1mM DTT] and lysed by passing through 26 gauge needled on ice. After centrifugation at 10000 g for 20 min at 4˚C the supernatant was collected and used for the binding reaction. 10µg of 3’-biotinylated PDCD4 3’UTR RNA were incubated with 500μg of MCF7 S10 lysate in binding buffer [10mM HEPES pH 7.0, 50 mM KCl, 10% glycerol, 1mM EDTA, 1mM DTT0, 0.15 μg/ml yeast tRNA and 100 u/ml RNase Inhibitor] for 4h at 4˚C followed by binding reaction with 50µl of high capacity streptavidin agarose bead (Thermo scientific ) for 2h at 4˚C.  The beads were washed four times with binding buffer containing 200 mM NaCl. The captured proteins were eluted by addition of 500 μl elution buffer containing 1M NaCl [10mM HEPES pH 7.0, 50 mM KCl, 10% glycerol, 1mM EDTA, 1mM DTT and 1M NaCl]. The eluted proteins were resolved in 10% SDS-PAGE after concentrating through 3kDa cut off centrifugal concentrator (Milipore). The gel was stained with fluorescence-based SYPRO ruby stain (Invitrogen). Excised protein bands following SDS-PAGE were digested in gel with trypsin and ran on LC-MS/MS
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Full MS in the mass range between m/z 375 and m/z 1700 was performed on an Orbitrap Mass analyzer, followed by CID-based MS/MS, performed in the scan range of m/z 100 and m/z 2000. Mascot Distiller software was used to identify the peptides with GG modification, in which the peptide mass tolerance threshold was set to 10ppm, and the maximum fragment mass tolerance was set between 0.6 Da.
